description: OCR a Japanese receipt (領収書/レシート) into structured JSON: merchant, transaction date & time, items, totals and the 8%/10% consumption-tax breakdown. The qualified-invoice registration number is extracted and verified against the National Tax Agency registry, so you know instantly whether the receipt supports input-tax credit (仕入税額控除). Accepts a LOCAL file path (photo or PDF, max 8MB) or a public URL. First page analyzed. Cost: $0.03 (x402/USDC). Failed analyses are not charged.

file.description: Local path to the receipt file (photo JPEG/PNG or PDF)

url.description: Public http(s) URL of the receipt (alternative to file)

name: read_japan_receipt
